title: The Current of Devil's Throat
author: Orsen Dravenmoor
blurb: Dominic Eastwick, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must cross the range ahead of the snows before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
